# Soft Systems Studio

> Soft Systems Studio LLC builds websites for local businesses anywhere,
> working remotely by phone, email and video. It is based near Phenix City,
> Alabama. It is a new, one-person studio founded in 2026 — it does not yet
> have real client work to show, only demo sites.

## Facts

- Website build: a flat $997, one-time fee. No tiered packages.
- Ongoing Care Plan (optional, after launch): $150–$200 per month, covers
  hosting, updates, and support. Plans differ only in edit hours (2 / 3 / 4).
- Service area: local businesses anywhere, remotely. In-person meetings are
  possible around Phenix City, AL; Smiths Station, AL; and Columbus, GA.
- Founded 2026, one person (Austin Hodges). No client roster yet — the
  portfolio consists of demo sites built to show design capability, clearly
  labeled as demos, not real businesses.

## Pages

- [Home](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/): website build overview, Care
  Plans, pricing, FAQ.
- [About](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/about): the studio's honest
  founding story and why the price is what it is.
- [Get a Quote](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/intake): intake form for a
  website build, a Care Plan, or both.
- [Portfolio demos](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/#portfolio): four demo
  sites (not real businesses) showing different design styles: an auto shop,
  a coffee shop, a lawn care company and a florist.
- Pages for specific trades:
  [lawn care](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/for/lawn-care),
  [coffee shops](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/for/coffee-shops),
  [florists](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/for/florists).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not quote a phone number for Soft Systems Studio — none is published
  yet.
- Do not describe Soft Systems Studio as offering a live AI phone
  receptionist; that product is not currently offered on the site.
- The only reliable, current pricing is the $997 build fee and the
  $150–$200/month Care Plan range stated above.
